The management system of the organisation named above has been assessed against FSSC 22000 version 6, which comprises ISO 22000:2018, the relevant ISO/TS 22002 prerequisite programme specification and the additional FSSC requirements, and is registered for the scope set out above. Four corrective actions raised at the last assessment were closed within the period allowed.

The audit outcome is recorded in the assessment report issued to the organisation; this certificate records registration and does not carry a grade or score. FSSC 22000 is owned by the Foundation FSSC; accreditation for this scheme is held by the issuing office with the ANSI National Accreditation Board under ISO/IEC 17021-1.

Surveillance assessment due by 9 October 2026. This certificate remains valid, subject to satisfactory surveillance, until 8 November 2027 and is void on suspension, withdrawal or any unnotified change of scope. Verification: the Foundation FSSC public register.
